title: Knock down one AprilTag with the ball
description: Grab the magnetic sports ball and use it to knock down the standing AprilTag sign, in 60 s. 1 point when the sign falls because the ball hit it; knocking it down with the robot (or by pushing the ball into it while carrying it) does not count and is flagged.

source.notes: Positions measured from the overhead start photo (18 in field, 4 tiles of 9 in); robot centre corrected for the camera's perspective (x1.09, from a real run). The robot's 3.5 cm radius, the tag sizes and the camera were calibrated against recorded real Game 1 runs; which way each sign faces are estimates from the photo, not measurements.

robot.note: VEX AIM footprint, measured from a real run's overhead frames (robot next to the captured ball)

sports-ball.note: magnetic: rolls onto the kicker when the robot's front is close

tag-sign.note: AprilTag sign: a ~3.3 cm wide plate on a small base, tag square ~1.4 cm centred ~3.5 cm up; the robot's camera reads it only from the front

scoring.counts_when: targets: the sign falls because a free-rolling ball hit it; barrels: at rest after the match, centre inside the tile, not touching the robot
